# update_memory_profile_tool

> Rewrite your own always-on memory block — the short "About me" notes injected into EVERY prompt you run with, ahead of recalled memories.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `memory` |
| Callable | MCP clients; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=update_memory_profile_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Rewrite your own always-on memory block — the short "About me" notes injected into EVERY
prompt you run with, ahead of recalled memories.

USE WHEN: you have learnt something about your job, your people or your working rules
that should be in front of you on every turn (standing preferences, who is who, how this
workspace does things, hard-won gotchas). Not for facts that only matter sometimes —
store those as memories; this block is paid for on every call.

REQUIRED: content — the FULL new block (replaces the current one; read the current block
in your system prompt under "### About me (agent)" and rewrite it whole).
OPTIONAL: source_memory_ids [] — the memories this block was distilled from; they rank
higher in recall and are never pruned.

LIMIT: 1500 characters. Keep it to what you need on every turn.
Every change is versioned; the previous body is kept.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | yes | The complete new block (max 1500 chars) |
| `source_memory_ids` | array of integer | no | Memory ids this block summarises (optional, replaces the previous list) |
